jobs.description:
ABOUT SAVVY WEALTH:

Wealth management is a $545 billion industry that still runs on manual work. 75% of advisors offer no digital communication beyond email, and most still build financial plans by hand in Excel. Savvy is reinventing what it looks like to be a financial advisor. Founder Ritik Malhotra saw the fragmentation firsthand after seeking out his own advisor, and started Savvy to give independent advisors a modern, AI-native home.

Savvy is a registered investment advisor (RIA), and we partner with experienced financial advisors who want to grow without running the back office themselves. Advisors bring their book and join Savvy, running under their own brand (or ours), and Savvy earns a percentage of the assets they manage. In return, they get a true business-in-a-box: a proprietary tech platform and client portal, an in-house marketing team that helps them grow, a world-class investment management team, and a dedicated client services team that runs day-to-day operations and support. Advisors at Savvy service up to 50% more households and save 19 hours a week.

AI runs through everything we do. On the product side, Savvy Intelligence (released April 2026) is the only AI built for wealth managers that can see a client's complete financial picture. Internally, everyone at Savvy uses Claude and is encouraged to experiment with it, backed by a dedicated AI enablement team and a RevOps org building agents in-house.

The trajectory is steep and it's still early. We're a Series C company with 170+ people, $200M raised, and $100M ARR in sight this year. Inc. ranked us the No. 1 fastest-growing financial services company in America in 2026. Come build the next stage with us!

We're a Certified Great Place to Work and have been honored for our culture and our growth:

- Newsweek's America's Greatest Startup Workplaces (2026)

- Fortune Best Workplaces in New York™ (2026)

- Great Place to Work Certified™

- Produce high-quality, production-ready, readable, maintainable code

- Work cross-functionally with product leadership, design, and business partners to deliver the best product.

MUST HAVE:

- 5-10 years building web applications with experience shipping features in production environments

- Full-stack development skills including web frameworks (Rails preferred), TypeScript, frontend frameworks and libraries (Next.js and React preferred), and SQL databases

- Experience writing automated tests across the stack (unit, integration, and end-to-end, e.g. RSpec, Vitest, Playwright) and treating tests as part of shipping a feature, not a follow-up

- Hands-on experience with AI coding tools (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor) as part of your daily workflow, including reviewing and testing AI-generated code with the same rigor as your own

- Strong collaboration and communication working effectively in cross-functional teams with clear technical communication skills

- Understanding of web application fundamentals including authentication/authorization, caching, background processing, and API design principles (GraphQL preferred)

NICE TO HAVE:

- Fintech domain knowledge including financial services, wealth management, regulatory compliance, or financial data integrations

- Modern development ecosystem experience with macOS toolchains, CI/CD pipelines, IaaS providers, and observability platforms (Datadog)

BENEFITS:

Build production-grade AI applications that support high-impact investment decisions.
Who is Parser ?
Technology alone does not create impact—the right teams do. Founded in 2018, Parser is a boutique technology services and consulting firm helping global organisations solve complex business challenges through digital transformation, product development and AI enablement. We are a fast-growing team of 340+ engineers and consultants across Europe, the Americas and the Middle East. We combine global reach with agility, senior expertise and close collaboration.
We work as an extension of our clients’ teams, helping them define the right problems, shape solutions and deliver technology-driven outcomes that create measurable business value. Our expertise spans software engineering, AI and data, product development, and customer experience.
If you want to think beyond execution, take ownership of outcomes, influence decisions and keep learning alongside top-tier specialists in a global environment, we’d love to meet you.
How will you impact?
You’ll help build and evolve an AI-enabled investment platform for a sovereign investor managing high-value assets across more than 50 countries.
The platform supports the investment lifecycle—from origination and due diligence to portfolio monitoring and valuation.
We value engineers who are resilient, adaptable, proactive, and comfortable operating in fast-paced, high-pressure environments, delivering high-quality software against demanding timelines and evolving priorities.
Your key responsibilities:

- Design, build and deploy production-grade applications using Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, React/Next.js and FastAPI.

- Develop AI-powered features such as LLM applications, RAG pipelines, vector search, AI agents and document intelligence.

- Build high-performance APIs, microservices, data integrations and intuitive frontend experiences.

- Deploy and operate containerised applications on Microsoft Azure and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), using Infrastructure as Code and CI/CD.

- Prototype and validate AI features, then turn successful experiments into secure, scalable products.

- Apply engineering best practices across system design, testing, security, AI guardrails and production observability.

- Collaborate with product, investment, data and technology teams to turn business needs into practical solutions.

- Take end-to-end ownership, troubleshoot production issues and keep delivery moving as priorities evolve.

What you’ll bring to the role:
Essential requirements:

- 8+ years of professional software engineering experience delivering production-grade applications.

- Strong hands-on Full Stack Expertise, particularly advanced Python and TypeScript/JavaScript, with experience in React/Next.js and backend development using FastAPI.

- Practical AI experience, building and deploying LLM-powered applications, RAG systems, vector search and AI agent workflows.

- Production experience with Microsoft Azure, Docker, Kubernetes—AKS required—and CI/CD.

- Advanced SQL, database design and API development skills, including experience working with structured and unstructured data.

- Familiarity with Snowflake, Oracle, Kafka, Event Hubs or large-scale data lakehouse architectures.

- A sound understanding of software architecture, scalability, security, testing and production observability.

- Proven end-to-end ownership and the ability to solve complex problems with minimal supervision.

- Resilience and adaptability, ability to perform effectively under pressure, manage shifting priorities, and maintain delivery momentum in demanding environments.

- Strong communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills, with a pragmatic, results-oriented engineering mindset.

Desirable requirements:

- Experience in financial services, fintech, investment management, private equity or capital markets technology.

- Experience working in the UAE or wider GCC, with distributed international teams, or on enterprise AI platforms.

- Experience in high-growth startups, AI product companies, or fast-paced engineering teams.

- Exposure to advanced agentic AI, LLM evaluation, performance optimisation, and enterprise AI platforms.

Location & work model

- Serbia – Fully Remote | 12-Month B2B Contract

Candidates must be flexible to accommodate UAE working hours and attend meetings as required. Specific working arrangements and expectations can be discussed further during the recruitment process.
You will receive:

- The chance to join a fast-growing organisation changing how software products are built.

- The opportunity to be part of a multicultural community of technology experts.

- Direct access to greenfield AI projects operating at institutional, global scale.

Parser is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace and providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants regardless of race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.
If you require reasonable accommodations during the recruitment process, please let us know and we will work with you to support your participation.
By applying to this role, you acknowledge that your personal data will be processed in accordance with Parser ’s Privacy Notice for recruitment purposes.
Parser may use AI-assisted tools during certain stages of the recruitment process to support operational efficiency. Our recruiting teams use AI to streamline note-taking and scheduling. All hiring decisions are made by people, with human review and oversight.

A história por trás desta vaga
Muitas vagas de engenharia de IA ainda giram em torno de experimentos, protótipos isolados ou pesquisa. Esta não é uma delas.
Na Cheesecake Labs , construímos software e soluções com IA para empresas reais, com usuários reais, restrições reais e prazos reais. Nossos squads são pequenos e seniores, e entregam em semanas e meses, não em anos.
Hoje, agentes de IA escrevem a maior parte do nosso código. Esta vaga é para quem decide como as coisas são construídas, direciona os agentes, verifica o resultado e responde por ele diante do cliente.
Estamos buscando uma pessoa Engenheira de Software Sênior: alguém que assume um projeto de cliente desde a primeira conversa de escopo até a produção, e que lida com as decisões de negócio, produto e técnica no caminho. Esta não é uma vaga de “receber tickets e implementar features”. Também não é uma vaga de “escrever cada linha na mão”.

- Rodar o nosso Spec Driven, nosso fluxo de desenvolvimento orientado a specs: reunir contexto, especificar, planejar, implementar por meio de agentes de IA, revisar e fechar o ciclo.

- Transformar um problema de negócio do cliente em um desenho técnico e em uma spec que um agente de IA consiga executar e que você consiga verificar.

- Revisar o que os agentes produzem, combinando loops automatizados de revisão com a sua própria checagem de arquitetura e comportamento, e responder por 100% do que é entregue.

- Tomar as decisões de arquitetura. A IA executa, você decide.

- Entregar e iterar, e depois fechar o ciclo devolvendo decisões e edge cases ao contexto do projeto, para que a próxima spec comece mais bem informada.

- Trabalhar dentro das regras de cada cliente sobre o uso de IA (veja Como usamos IA aqui).

New roles for Senior React Full-stack Engineers come in all the time, and several are open right now.
Two ways to work with clients

- Contract: most roles are contract-based. You join the client’s team and work as part of it.

- Direct hire: some clients hire engineers full-time, and we support you through the process.

Because companies trust our vetting, applying through is often a shortcut. You get to the client faster than going through their full hiring process on your own.
What you get

- Competitive rate, based on your seniority and skills

- We find the projects. No client hunting or rate negotiations. We match you manually based on your skills and preferences.

- Flexible schedule. Work async or with a small overlap with the team’s hours.

- No micromanagement, no screen trackers

- Direct work with clients, most of them with technical backgrounds

- Ongoing support from your application through every project, plus a community of engineers from 75+ countries

Who we’re looking for
Senior React & Python Developers:

- 4+ years of software development experience.

Commercial experience:

-
React.js 3+ years & Python 3+ years

OR
React.js 2+ years & Python 5+ years
OR
React.js 5+ years & Python 2+ years

- Experience with AWS, GCP, or Azure is required.

Senior Node & React Developers:

- 5+ years of software development experience

Commercial experience:

- React.js: 3+ years, Node.js: 5+ years, and Next.js: 2+ years
OR
React.js: 5+ years, Node.js: 3+ years, and Next.js: 2+ years

- Expertise in TypeScript, AWS and AI-assisted coding is a must.

How it works

- Apply and complete your profile

- Verify your role

- Once approved, we match you with a project. Typical time to first project: 3 weeks

Ready? Apply and join the community.
NOT YOUR TECH STACK?
We're placing Senior Developers (4+ yrs commercial experience) across AI Agent Architecture, AI Automation Architecture, AI Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, Platform Engineering, Enterprise Software Engineering, Magento & PHP, React & Golang, Golang, React & Java, React & Ruby, Ruby, PHP & Vue, Vue & Node.js, React & .NET, Android & iOS, iOS & Swift, Flutter & Firebase, Solutions Engineer, Blockchain (Ethereum/Ethers.js/Wagmi/Viem/Solana), Angular & Node.js, Vue & .NET, Python & Vue, DevOps, MLOps, Data Science, Angular & PHP, Angular & .NET, Symfony & React, Symfony & Vue, Symfony & Angular, Python, Symfony & JavaScript & Next.js & TypeScript, Data Analysis, React & PHP, Data Engineering, Project Management, Product Management, QA Automation, QA Manual, Embedded Software Engineering, React Native & Node, React Native & React, React Native & Ruby, React Native & Python, WordPress, Android, Angular, Python & Node, Node & TypeScript, Java & Spring, Svelte & Python, Svelte & Node.js, Svelte & TypeScript, Rust, Shopify & JavaScript, Vue & Nuxt, PHP & Laravel, UI/UX Design, Animation, Graphic Design, React & Node & React Native, .NET & C#, Electron, Scala, C++, Unreal Engine & C++, Python & LLM, Unity, or Machine Learning Engineering and more. Reach out and we'll match you.
We do not provide visa assistance, and our cooperation model does not include the benefits typically offered with direct hire.
We work with developers from 75+ countries across Europe, Latin America, North America (the U.S. and Canada), selected countries in Asia (Japan, Singapore, South Korea, the Philippines, Indonesia, Malaysia, Vietnam, Thailand, Saudi Arabia, UAE, and Israel), Oceania (Australia, New Zealand, and Papua New Guinea), and Africa (including Morocco and South Africa).
